description: This file defines the CheckoutModel class for handling the checkout page logic in an ASP.NET Razor Pages application. It manages basket retrieval, order creation, and user session handling during checkout.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: Represents the server-side logic for the checkout page, including basket management, order creation, and user session handling.

methods.name: CheckoutModel
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for basket, order, user management, and logging.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize the basket view model.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the checkout, create an order, and clear the basket.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the basket model based on user login state.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Sets or retrieves a cookie for anonymous user basket management.
